proposal.reason: Main change is to logical graph channel/ring behavior, so graph-search owns it: src/graph/connect.cc rewires ring reversal timing into ncclTopoPostset, preserves per-algorithm channelMap during channel copy/shuffle, and fixes compCap80 channel remap math; src/graph/search.cc switches ncclTopoGetNetDev to graph->channelMap and only reuses cached proxyDevs when sender+NIC match, otherwise recomputes path. src/include/graph.h adds channelMap/ringReverse to support that contract. init.cc changes are feature setup for the same graph logic, not an independent communicator/network policy change.
